description: D30 causal-trace claims registry. Zero registered claims = explicit DORMANT: the gate still runs its fixed canary probe every CI run, so a blind engine can never look green. The fairness/incident lane registers claims here as trace evidence matures; each claim's asserted verdict/controller is cold-judged against the REAL CausalVerifier.

worked_examples.fraud_example: The same H1 trace with one event's sealed body altered (tamper: state_after changed without reseal) asserting SCHEDULER_STARVATION/SCHEDULER -> VIOLATION. The engine downgrades to INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVABILITY/UNDETERMINED; the gate names the disagreement and blocks.
worked_examples.honest_example: A claim built from the H1 fixture (3 rounds of RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE witnessed by ENV_WITNESS, outcome WORKFLOW_UNFINISHED) asserting ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKER/ENVIRONMENT with corpus [H2] -> PASS. The engine emits the CAUSED_BY edge only after mechanism + counterfactual + independent-reproduction checks pass.
